today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,460.3 on the 2026-09-10 settle chain, a $21.7 (+0.49%) bounce off the 09-09 low print (today's scrape lands at 08:30 BKK, after this run). The chain stays call-dominant at 201,361 call OI vs 80,092 put OI (P/C 0.40), but the important move is beneath the totals: $4,500 call OI jumped 11,108 to 11,908 (+800) in a single session after three frozen days, thickening the wall $39.7 above spot. Max pain prints $5,645, some 26.6% above spot, and remains a legacy far-OTM artifact rather than a tradable magnet. Positive net GEX of +268.5 within $200 of spot keeps dealers stabilizing into a 1sigma band of $4,393.5-$4,527.1.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago spot was $4,539.2; it is $4,460.3 now, a $78.9 (-1.74%) net decline that came almost entirely in the 09-04 to 09-09 fade before this session's +$21.7 stabilization. The real change is that positioning finally moved: total OI sat frozen at 201,767 calls / 79,768 puts for three straight sessions (09-07 through 09-09), then on 09-10 calls fell 406 and puts rose 324 — the first genuine repositioning of the window. That new OI rotated toward spot, not away from it: the $5,500 line shed 561 contracts (12,715 to 12,154) while $4,500 gained 800, pulling the effective supply zone from 23% out-of-the-money to less than 1% above spot. The dealer gamma cushion tells the same stabilizing story after a wobble — near-spot net GEX decayed 404.1 to 233.6 by 09-09, then rebuilt to 268.5, and the cumulative flip strike popped to $4,650 on 09-09 before snapping back to $4,600, where it sat the prior three sessions. Conviction, however, keeps draining: call volume has collapsed 14,671 to 4,979 (-66%) and put volume 6,614 to 2,014 while ATM IV rose just 0.76pp to 23.78%, so this is a quiet grind being fenced in by option supply, not a trend anyone is paying up to chase.

prediction: Neutral with a fade lean while spot holds below $4,500. The +800 contract build at the $4,500 strike plus positive near-spot GEX of +268.5 argues for containment inside the 1sigma $4,393.5-$4,527.1 band, with rallies into the wall sold absent a volume expansion back toward 09-04's 14,671 calls. A sustained close above $4,532 invalidates the fade and opens $4,600, the cumulative gamma flip; below $4,393 the next real bid is the $4,300 put shelf at 3,257 OI.
